messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — canary wave 'wave-3' failing health checks in us-west-2: 5xx spike > 8% over 3m, latency p95 increased. auto-abort criteria met.
ria: paging oncall. i'm on it, pulling logs now. :rotating_light:
darren: oncall here, will take primary. what's the customer impact?
ria: early look — failures concentrated on the gen-backend group serving /v1/generate, traffic ~2.7% of total but higher error burst for longer prompts. sample logs:```ERROR 2026-05-18T22:13:06Z gen: token_stream: kv-cache mismatch -> 5xx```
sylvia: i see increased auth errors from the canary instances too, maybe a rollout config that changed header passthrough.
alex: i rolled the config for rollout_v3 earlier — changed proxy header `x-client-id` behavior, but that shouldn't 5xx. investigating knob changes now.
ops-bot: rolling back traffic for wave-3 to baseline (policy: immediate abort) — starting traffic shift: 25% -> 0% over 2m.
darren: execute kill-switch flag and open rollback. ria, can you apply the emergency flag?
ria: toggling feature flag now -> `redwood flags set rollout_v3 false --scope=wave-3` (output: OK). enabling kill-switch: `curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/flags/rollout_v3/disable` -> 200 OK.
sylvia: confirmed traffic shift started, new instances drained. health checks for drained hosts trending to healthy for prod baseline.
alex: i'm pausing autoscaler to avoid spin-up thrash: `kubectl scale deployment/gen --replicas=0 --namespace=wave-3` (temporary).
darren: CS/Support notify? any paying customers hit?
csn-bot: (automated) flagged 2 enterprise customers with increased error rates: AcmeCorp and FinchAnalytics. severity: degraded non-blocking. sending CSM notes.
cs m-bot: sorry typo above, meant csm-bot: message sent to CSM channel with suggested blurb.
ria: quick customer impact summary: ~45 requests failed for AcmeCorp in the last 10m, FinchAnalytics saw degraded throughput (timeouts). no complete outages. recommending proactive email and Slack DM.
darren: good. post-rollback checklist: 1) confirm 5xx rate back to baseline 2) preserve canary logs for postmortem 3) hold on re-rollout until root cause found.
ops-bot: 5xx rate for gen-backend now back to baseline (2m avg). monitoring for 10m.
sylvia: saving logs: `tar -czf /tmp/wave3-logs-2981112223.tgz /var/log/gen/*` and uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-incident-logs/wave3/2981112223.tgz
ria: handoff to next oncall @darren — i'll create an incident ticket and link logs. current status: rollback started, kill-switch enabled, customer comms sent, monitoring stable. please escalate if any regression.
darren: ack, taking follow-up. i'll open an incident page and assign postmortem owner. thanks all. :thumbsup:
